# RevenueDot

> RevenueDot is an open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hostable backend for in-app purchases and subscriptions that works with the RevenueCat SDK. It is a free alternative to RevenueCat: change one line (the SDK's proxy URL) and keep your app code. SDKs are MIT forks with the same API as RevenueCat's.

## Docs
- [Website](https://revenuedot.app)
- [Server repository](https://github.com/revenuedot/revenuedot): API, dashboard, self-hosting
- [Examples](https://github.com/revenuedot/examples): runnable apps and backends for every stack
- [This documentation](https://github.com/revenuedot/docs)

## SDKs (MIT, same API as RevenueCat)
- [iOS](https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-ios), [Android](https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-android), [React Native](https://github.com/revenuedot/react-native-purchases), [Flutter](https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-flutter), [Web](https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-js), [Capacitor](https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-capacitor), [KMP](https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-kmp), [Unity](https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-unity), [Cordova](https://github.com/revenuedot/cordova-plugin-purchases)

## AI
- [MCP server](https://github.com/revenuedot/mcp), [agent skills](https://github.com/revenuedot/agent-skills)
